item.title: Programme Lead / Senior Programme Associate - Clean Energy
item.description: The selected candidate will drive research, policy advisory, and implementation for the Clean Energy Programme. You will work closely with state governments and industrial stakeholders to accelerate renewable energy deployment across India. The role involves managing workstreams, conducting techno-economic assessments, and providing regulatory recommendations to support equitable energy transitions in priority regions.
item.author: International Forum for Environment, Sustainability & Technology (iFOREST) (Noida)

item.title: Senior Energy Researcher and Policy Consultant
item.description: The successful candidate will join the Global Integrated Assessment Modelling team to analyze energy transition pathways and decarbonization strategies. You will apply quantitative models like Prometheus to generate policy-relevant insights for national and global climate processes. This role requires bridging the gap between complex data analysis and actionable policy recommendations for diverse stakeholders.
item.author: WSP in India (Mumbai)

item.title: Regional Health and WaSH Coordinator
item.description: The Regional Health and WaSH Coordinator provides strategic leadership for health and sanitation programs across India, Bangladesh, Nepal, and Myanmar. You will oversee regional strategy implementation, ensure technical quality, and support country-level teams in managing complex interventions. This role requires extensive experience in public health and WaSH programming to drive sustainable impact for children and vulnerable communities within the Asia Hub.
item.author: Terre des hommes (Remote (India))

item.title: Research Intern - Technology Futures
item.description: The Technology Futures team at CEEW focuses on evaluating emerging clean energy technologies and their integration into the Indian power sector. Interns will assist in data collection, literature reviews, and quantitative analysis to support policy research reports. This role provides an opportunity to contribute to evidence-based climate solutions while working alongside senior researchers in a leading policy think-tank.
item.author: Council on Energy, Environment and Water (CEEW) (Remote (India))

item.title: Programme Associate – Energy Transitions
item.description: The Council on Energy, Environment and Water is seeking a Programme Associate to support its energy transitions team. You will contribute to rigorous research and policy analysis aimed at accelerating India's shift toward sustainable energy systems. This role involves working closely with senior researchers to produce evidence-based insights that inform national climate policy and infrastructure development strategies.
item.author: Council on Energy, Environment and Water (CEEW) (Remote (India))

item.title: Chief of Partnerships
item.description: UNAccc is hiring a Chief of Partnerships to drive global strategic alliances supporting climate action and Sustainable Development Goals. Based in Vadodara in a hybrid setup, the role leads engagement with governments, multilateral agencies, educational institutions, and corporate entities. The executive will negotiate formal agreements and monitor partnership metrics to report impact to board leadership.
item.author: UNAccc (Unity of Nations Action for Climate Change Council) (Vadodara)

item.title: Research Analyst / Programme Associate - Technology Futures
item.description: The Technology Futures team at CEEW focuses on the intersection of emerging technologies and climate action. You will conduct rigorous research to support policy frameworks for low-carbon transitions across energy and industrial sectors. This role involves data analysis and stakeholder engagement to influence national climate strategies while working within a leading Indian policy think-tank.
item.author: Council on Energy, Environment and Water (CEEW) (Remote (India))

item.title: Compliance Executive (Environmental Engineer)
item.description: This role involves managing environmental regulatory compliance for industrial projects in Gujarat. You will serve as the primary liaison with the GPCB to secure and renew essential consents like CTE and CCA. The position requires frequent interaction with the Xtended Green Node portal to ensure all technical documentation and hazardous waste returns remain current.
item.author: Peregreen Enviro India Pvt. Ltd. (Ahmedabad)
